overall_description: A modern tower fan with a tall rectangular housing, a circular pedestal base, and a top control deck carrying rotary knobs, plus a carry handle integrated into the rear of the top cap. the tower body stays visibly separate from the base joint that provides oscillation, and the handle remains a real opening or supported bridge in the cap. The tower body oscillates on a vertical revolute joint above the base, the internal blower wheel rotates continuously about the vertical center axis, and the rotary controls turn continuously on their local axes. Residential tower-fan scale.
